method: Agent-operated Chrome browser walkthrough with fictional fixtures, not human or native-device testing

steps.title: One menu, three audience types
steps.result: Eight entries; private, public channel and external email have text labels and distinct surfaces.

steps.title: Open a relationship, keep the list
steps.result: Maya expands in place. Reply draft belongs to Maya.

steps.title: Private work before sharing
steps.result: Proposal and audience are shown beside the retained unsent reply.

steps.title: Image and caption have an audience
steps.result: Sample illustration; no picker or camera integration.

steps.title: Inspect trust without implying verification
steps.result: No real security code; invitation and verification are explicitly different.

steps.title: A publication is not a private conversation
steps.result: Public readers, reading mode and comments-off state are explicit.

steps.title: External email keeps its source
steps.result: Sender and email reply recipient are visible; no mailbox is connected.

steps.title: Review what crosses the boundary
steps.result: Only selected text will enter Maya’s chat; addresses, attachments and original email stay outside.

steps.title: Selected detail arrives in Maya
steps.result: Only the reviewed text appears; transport remains explicit in the source.

steps.title: Queued is not sent
steps.result: Offline scenario queues locally.

steps.title: An uncertain outcome needs inspection
steps.result: Outcome unknown exposes check rather than a blind resend.

steps.title: Selective visibility
steps.result: Quiet hides previews and folds active work; it is not authentication or device locking.

steps.title: Alternate material, same behaviour
steps.result: Charcoal changes appearance while retaining the relationship state.

steps.title: Connection handoff to the comparative study
steps.result: Inline menu leaves its page for the nine-context connection study; inline state is not shared.

steps.title: Pending invitation is not connection
steps.result: Demo invitation shows disclosure and pending state.

steps.result: Separate nine-screen baseline; not equivalent to a completed inline implementation.
